blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
I'm Aatish, a senior software developer with 4+ years of hands-on experience building React applications.
When I first learned hooks, the explanations I found were mostly API documentation that told me what each hook accepts and returns, with a small counter example at the end.
That left me able to copy patterns but not understand them. When something broke, I didn't know why.
So I want your first introduction to hooks to be completely different from how I experienced it.
How, you might ask? Let me explain this through my teaching philosophy.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
